title: Tallis Home Products: communications team and a customer data incident
summary: The corporate communications team of a Dayton, Ohio home products manufacturer (1.9 million web store accounts, a vendor-hosted store, a Form 8-K clock and a hostile news cycle), with an exercise generated from its simulated plans: a hacker forum claim, a trade reporter's deadline, a false viral post, a wrong first statement that must be corrected, and customer, retailer and investor messages that must agree with the filing.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Tallis Home Products, its web store vendor, retailers, outlets, reporters, advisers and people are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/tallis-comms/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Sample Rows
scenarios.summary: On a Tuesday morning a hacker forum post claims to sell 1.9 million Tallis customer accounts; the team must issue a holding statement within the hour, answer a trade reporter and a false viral claim, correct its own first statement, and keep the customer email, the press line and the Form 8-K consistent while the stock falls.
